title: When should Steve plant?
_map: Days, weeks, months (Y1). Big idea: ordering time. Creative: build a calendar for the farm's crops: what grows in which month?
_story: Steve wants to plant crops but doesn't know the order of days and months. A calendar of squares, 7 in a row for a week. Ismaeel finds patterns and plans when to plant.
_stepChain: days have names in order → 7 days make a week → a calendar shows weeks as rows of 7 → about 4 weeks make a month → 12 months make a year → plan the farm

talk.ask: How many days are in a week? Can you say them in order?
talk.goodAnswer: 7: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

talk.ask: On a calendar, why does each row have 7 squares?
talk.goodAnswer: each row is one week, and a week has 7 days.

handsOn: Look at a real calendar. Find your birthday month. Count how many weeks until your next birthday!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I want to plant carrots! But when? I don't even know what comes after Tuesday!
The days go round in order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Then Monday again. 7 days together are called a week.
A calendar puts each week in a row of 7 squares. Look: the Sundays all line up, down the last column. Every 7 days, it's Sunday again.
About 4 weeks make a longer time called a month. There are 12 months in a year: January, February, March, all the way to December.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: The carrots take 3 weeks to grow. How many days is that?

0.hint: Each week is a whole row of 7 days. How many rows?
0.say: Each week is 7 days. 3 weeks is 3 rows of 7: 7, 14, 21.

2.hint: 37 is the 3 and the 7 side by side. Count 3 rows of 7 instead.
2.say: Count 3 rows of 7 on the calendar: 7, 14, 21 days.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Now help me plan! Seeds go in the ground in spring, around March or April. Carrots are ready in summer. Pumpkins in autumn. Make your own farm calendar with a grown-up!

rule.text: 7 days make a week. 12 months make a year.
rule.ask: Can you say the days of the week in order? Say them out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: 7 days make a week, about 4 weeks make a month, and 12 months make a year.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: about how many days are in a whole year?
bonus.reveal: 365 days! And every 4 years there's an extra one: 366.
